title: All things work together for good
text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
emphasis: all things work together for good

title: Hope and a future
text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

title: Faith is assurance
text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

title: I will do a new thing
text: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
emphasis: I will do a new thing

title: New every morning
text: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

title: With God all things are possible
text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.
emphasis: with God all things are possible

title: Nothing spoken by God is impossible
text: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
emphasis: nothing spoken by God is impossible

title: The light of life
text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.

title: Faith, hope, and love
text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

title: Renewed day by day
text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

title: We are his workmanship
text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

title: A tree planted by the streams of water
text: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
emphasis: a tree planted by the streams of water

title: Guide me in your truth
text: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

title: He is our help and our shield
text: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
emphasis: He is our help and our shield

title: The hope of salvation
text: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

title: My expectation is from him
text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

title: The LORD will fulfill
text: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

title: The LORD will guide you continually
text: And the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
emphasis: the LORD will guide you continually

title: Blessed is the man who trusts
text: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
emphasis: Blessed is the man who trusts

title: You are my hope
text: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

title: The world should be saved through him
text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
emphasis: the world should be saved through him

title: Free indeed
text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

title: Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved
text: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.
emphasis: Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved

title: Therefore I will hope in him
text: The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.
emphasis: Therefore I will hope in him

title: Your faith and hope might be in God
text: Who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
emphasis: your faith and hope might be in God

title: Christ is faithful
text: But Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

title: All his work is done in faithfulness
text: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
emphasis: All his work is done in faithfulness

title: Loving kindness
text: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

title: Hope in his loving kindness
text: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

title: My peace I give to you
text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
emphasis: My peace I give to you

title: Perfect peace
text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

title: Don’t let your heart be troubled
text: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
emphasis: Don’t let your heart be troubled

title: In nothing be anxious
text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

title: The peace of God
text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

title: You shall be still
text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.

title: I will put my trust in you
text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
emphasis: I will put my trust in you

title: An everlasting Rock
text: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

title: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts
text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
emphasis: let the peace of God rule in your hearts

title: Give you peace
text: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

title: Bless his people with peace
text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

title: Rest in the LORD
text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

title: Blessed are the peacemakers
text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

title: Set your mind on the things that are above
text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
emphasis: Set your mind on the things that are above

title: Trust in the LORD with all your heart
text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
emphasis: Trust in the LORD with all your heart

title: The meditation of my heart
text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

title: Renew a right spirit within me
text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
emphasis: Renew a right spirit within me

title: Kept safe
text: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

title: Enjoy safe pasture
text: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

title: The God of peace
text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Grace to you and peace
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: God’s love
text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

title: I trust in you
text: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.

title: Put your trust in the LORD
text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
emphasis: Put your trust in the LORD

title: None of his steps shall slide
text: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
emphasis: None of his steps shall slide

title: The LORD his trust
text: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

title: His way is perfect
text: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

title: The LORD is your keeper
text: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

title: I will strengthen you
text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

title: God is our refuge and strength
text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
emphasis: God is our refuge and strength

title: Be strong and courageous
text: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

title: Renew their strength
text: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

title: My grace is sufficient for you
text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
emphasis: My grace is sufficient for you

title: If God is for us
text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

title: I have overcome the world
text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.

title: Be strong and courageous
text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.

title: He will not fail you
text: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.

title: I shall not be moved
text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

title: My rock, my fortress, and my deliverer
text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
emphasis: my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer

title: The LORD is my light and my salvation
text: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
emphasis: The LORD is my light and my salvation

title: Let your heart take courage
text: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

title: Be strong
text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

title: God is the strength of my heart
text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
emphasis: God is the strength of my heart

title: My help comes from the LORD
text: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
emphasis: My help comes from the LORD

title: A strong tower
text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

title: I will trust, and will not be afraid
text: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.
emphasis: I will trust, and will not be afraid

title: Be strong in the Lord
text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

title: Power, love, and self-control
text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

title: Our strength every morning
text: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

title: Seek the LORD and his strength
text: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
emphasis: Seek the LORD and his strength

title: I will come out like gold
text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
emphasis: I will come out like gold

title: We trust in the name of the LORD
text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
emphasis: we trust in the name of the LORD

title: He gives power to the weak
text: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
emphasis: He gives power to the weak

title: Mighty in power
text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

title: Their stronghold in the time of trouble
text: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
emphasis: their stronghold in the time of trouble

title: I will not be afraid
text: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

title: Rejoice in the Lord always
text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!

title: Delight yourself in the LORD
text: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

title: The joy of the LORD is your strength
text: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
emphasis: the joy of the LORD is your strength

title: Joy comes in the morning
text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

title: A cheerful heart
text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

title: I will rejoice in the LORD
text: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
emphasis: I will rejoice in the LORD

title: The rejoicing of my heart
text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD, God of Armies.

title: Gladness of heart
text: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

title: Rejoicing the heart
text: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

title: Shout for joy
text: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

title: Shout for joy and be glad
text: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!
emphasis: shout for joy and be glad

title: We also rejoice in God
text: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

title: Gladness in my heart
text: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

title: I delight to do your will
text: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.
emphasis: I delight to do your will

title: Sing for joy
text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

title: Our mouth was filled with laughter
text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.
emphasis: our mouth was filled with laughter

title: We rejoice in hope
text: Through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

title: Glad in the LORD
text: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

title: Serve the LORD with gladness
text: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

title: My heart exults in the LORD
text: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
emphasis: My heart exults in the LORD

title: The light of your presence
text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

title: We will triumph in your salvation
text: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
emphasis: We will triumph in your salvation

title: Let your hearts live forever
text: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

title: Our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing
text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
emphasis: our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing

title: Life, and may have it abundantly
text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
emphasis: life, and may have it abundantly

title: Bears much fruit
text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

title: Blessed are the pure in heart
text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
emphasis: Blessed are the pure in heart

title: Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed
text: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
emphasis: Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed

title: I will give you rest
text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

title: The LORD is near
text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

title: He will sustain you
text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

title: God’s love
text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: He will wipe away every tear
text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.
emphasis: He will wipe away every tear

title: The LORD is my shepherd
text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

title: You are with me
text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

title: Grace for help in time of need
text: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
emphasis: grace for help in time of need

title: I will in no way leave you
text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.
emphasis: I will in no way leave you

title: I am with you
text: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.

title: Delivered me from all my fears
text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
emphasis: delivered me from all my fears

title: Your comforts delight my soul
text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

title: I will be with you
text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

title: My loving kindness will not depart from you
text: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.
emphasis: my loving kindness will not depart from you

title: So far has he removed our transgressions
text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
emphasis: so far has he removed our transgressions

title: He will keep your soul
text: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

title: The LORD is near
text: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

title: He heals the broken in heart
text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
emphasis: He heals the broken in heart

title: You were healed by his wounds
text: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
emphasis: You were healed by his wounds

title: The shadow of your wings
text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

title: Your tender mercies
text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

title: He saved me
text: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

title: Comforted myself
text: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

title: You help the victim and the fatherless
text: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
emphasis: You help the victim and the fatherless

title: The LORD will sustain him
text: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

title: Compassion on his children
text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

title: The LORD redeems the soul
text: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

title: Remain in my love
text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

title: I have called you by your name
text: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
emphasis: I have called you by your name

title: Give thanks to the LORD
text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

title: I will praise him
text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

title: Singing with grace in your heart
text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
emphasis: singing with grace in your heart

title: Taste and see that the LORD is good
text: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
emphasis: taste and see that the LORD is good

title: He withholds no good thing
text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

title: Abundant in loving kindness
text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

title: Merciful and gracious
text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

title: You have done wonderful things
text: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

title: Every good gift and every perfect gift
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
emphasis: Every good gift and every perfect gift

title: To your name give glory
text: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

title: The LORD remembers us
text: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

title: Worthy to be praised
text: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

title: With my whole heart
text: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

title: With my song I will thank him
text: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
emphasis: With my song I will thank him

title: You are very great
text: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

title: Thanks be to God
text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Sing and praise your power
text: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

title: Marvelous loving kindness
text: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

title: Your faithfulness reaches to the skies
text: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
emphasis: Your faithfulness reaches to the skies

title: Give thanks to the LORD
text: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

title: His wonderful deeds
text: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

title: His wonderful works
text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

title: Our God is merciful
text: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

title: Faithfulness endures forever
text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

title: His loving kindness endures forever
text: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

title: The heavens will praise your wonders
text: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
emphasis: The heavens will praise your wonders

title: The sacrifice of thanksgiving
text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

title: The earth is full of your riches
text: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
emphasis: The earth is full of your riches

title: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live
text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
emphasis: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live

title: Be still
text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.

title: The LORD is good
text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

title: We will rejoice
text: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

title: In peace
text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

title: Through Christ
text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

title: He cares for you
text: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

title: Abound in hope
text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

title: Fullness of joy
text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

title: His loving kindness
text: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
